references.text: Moses gives the same promise to all Israel: The Lord will go before them; he will not let them go or forsake them; they shall not fear or be afraid.
God gives Joshua the promise that he will be with him just as he was with Moses, and that he will not let him go or forsake him.
God commands Joshua to be strong and courageous, not to fear or lose heart, for the Lord his God is with him wherever he goes.
God promises Jacob that he will be with him and keep him wherever he goes.
The Lord promises Moses that his face shall go with the people and give them rest.
God exhorts his people not to fear, for he is with them and will strengthen and help them.
God promises to be with his people when they pass through water and fire.
The author quotes God's promise that he will never let go or forsake his people, a direct reference to this verse.
David encourages Solomon with the same words: do not be afraid, for the Lord your God is with you; he will not let you go or forsake you.
David expresses confidence that the Lord is his light and salvation, therefore he does not fear.
